# DocumentEncryptionExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Extension methods for configuring PDF document encryption.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`WithEncryption`](#withencryption): Configures encryption with the specified settings.
- [`WithEncryption128`](#withencryption128): Configures 128-bit RC4 encryption (standard for PDF 1.4).
- [`WithEncryption40`](#withencryption40): Configures 40-bit RC4 encryption (legacy, not recommended for new documents).
- [`WithEncryptionAes256`](#withencryptionaes256): Configures AES-256 encryption (PDF 1.7 required).
- [`WithoutEncryption`](#withoutencryption): Removes encryption from the document settings.
- [`WithPassword`](#withpassword): Configures encryption with a simple user password (128-bit RC4, all permissions).
- [`WithPasswords`](#withpasswords): Configures encryption with user and owner passwords (128-bit RC4).

### `WithEncryption`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithEncryption(DocumentSettings settings, EncryptionSettings encryptionSettings)
```

*static*

Configures encryption with the specified settings.

- `settings`: The document settings
- `encryptionSettings`: The encryption settings to use

### `WithEncryption128`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithEncryption128(DocumentSettings settings, Action<EncryptionOptions> configure)
```

*static*

Configures 128-bit RC4 encryption (standard for PDF 1.4).

- `settings`: The document settings
- `configure`: Action to configure encryption options

### `WithEncryption40`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithEncryption40(DocumentSettings settings, Action<EncryptionOptions> configure)
```

*static*

Configures 40-bit RC4 encryption (legacy, not recommended for new documents).

- `settings`: The document settings
- `configure`: Action to configure encryption options

### `WithEncryptionAes256`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithEncryptionAes256(DocumentSettings settings, Action<EncryptionOptions> configure)
```

*static*

Configures AES-256 encryption (PDF 1.7 required). Automatically sets Version to Pdf17.

- `settings`: The document settings
- `configure`: Action to configure encryption options

### `WithoutEncryption`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithoutEncryption(DocumentSettings settings)
```

*static*

Removes encryption from the document settings.

- `settings`: The document settings

### `WithPassword`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithPassword(DocumentSettings settings, string userPassword)
```

*static*

Configures encryption with a simple user password (128-bit RC4, all permissions).

- `settings`: The document settings
- `userPassword`: The password required to open the document

### `WithPasswords`

```csharp
DocumentSettings WithPasswords(DocumentSettings settings, string userPassword, string ownerPassword, PdfPermissions permissions = PdfPermissions.All)
```

*static*

Configures encryption with user and owner passwords (128-bit RC4).

- `settings`: The document settings
- `userPassword`: The password required to open the document
- `ownerPassword`: The password required to change permissions
- `permissions`: The permissions to grant
